thesis: United Therapeutics is a net-cash, high-margin PAH/ILD drug maker (gross margin about 86% in 9M26) trading near 19.5x TTM GAAP earnings after a 7% drop on 2026-11-05; pipeline catalysts (Nebulized Tyvaso for IPF sNDA and ralinepag NDA both under FDA review) and a 2.0B new buyback support the case. Quality is clear; price attractiveness is unestablished because core revenue growth has stalled.
counterthesis: 9M26 revenue +0.2% and net income -10.7% vs 9M25; management says competitive therapies (Winrevair, Yutrepia, generic Remodulin) hurt Nebulized Tyvaso, Tyvaso DPI and Remodulin; Nebulized Tyvaso -12% in Q3; 9M inventory reserve 75.5M; Q4 will carry a 525M ralinepag royalty buyout expense offset by a 330.4M Liquidia gain; FDA decisions are binary; IRA price negotiation risk; 3.5B of capital returned via ASRs since mid-2025 shrinks the cash cushion; capex rising (562M TTM); remaining Liquidia installments depend on counterparty; stock-based comp 118M in 9M.
invalidation: Tyvaso franchise revenue declining for two more quarters, FDA rejection or delay of Nebulized Tyvaso for IPF or ralinepag, Remodulin generic erosion accelerating, gross margin below 80%, or cash plus investments falling below about 2B.
